title: Post-hurricane review for people with disabilities
summary: A request for a post-hurricane review will go on the next meeting's agenda, after written public testimony raised the idea on September 10. Commissioners discussed asking the emergency management agency how the recent hurricane affected people with disabilities and for information it collected after the storm. One commissioner said a review could show whether welfare checks were done and help prepare for future storms.
